question: What claim about the figures named is at stake in calling independent family-impellers by the name four-age in address to the lord of gods?
premises: They are addressed in relation to the independent lord of gods.
inference: A class of independent family-impellers is designated by the term four-age in this address.
uncertainties: The exact referents of kulacodakāḥ remain unclear from this verse alone.
plain_english: Four-age, thus, O lord of gods, O independent ones, are the family-impellers.
